provenance.correctness_note: Real numerical parity against an independent float64 golden (scripts/task_runner.py:_golden) transcribed from fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule_fwd_kernel(IS_KDA=True) + fused_kda_gate/kda_gate_fwd_kernel. Gate g_t = -exp(A_log_h)*softplus(raw_g+dt_bias); per-token recurrence: q=l2norm(q)*scale, k=l2norm(k); S=S*exp(g_t) (per k-column); v-=S@k; v*=beta; S+=outer(v,k); o=S@q. Verified: chunk_kda_with_fused_gate matches the golden at cos=0.99999 (rel_max_err<0.007); the packed-decode recurrent path also matches at cos=0.99999 when called with ssm_state_indices=None + inplace_final_state=False. Gate: correctness asserts cos>0.999 and normalized max error <0.03. Performance (CUDA-graph timing) is the optimization target.
provenance.input_note: q/k/v/raw_g/beta/A_log/dt_bias are freshly generated (kernel timing/consistency, not accuracy). Layout [1, total_tokens, H, D] with cu_seqlens, matching the real caller's rearrange 'n (h d) -> 1 n h d'.
